summary: Tested image management features (delete/reorder in DealDetails.js + PropertyIntelligencePanel.js) and field name fixes for asking_price/size_sqft. All 12 backend tests passed. Found and fixed a critical bug: server.py POST /api/deals/{deal_id}/images was not returning image_urls in response, causing carousel update to fail after upload. Frontend verified via code review (auth-gated, no test credentials available).

backend_delete_image_endpoint.details: New endpoint exists, requires auth (401/403), removes image from array, updates DB, returns {success, image_urls}

backend_reorder_images_endpoint.details: New endpoint exists, requires auth, validates ImageReorderPayload, updates image_urls order in DB

dealdetails_image_upload_button.details: Add Images button with data-testid='add-images-button', calls POST, now correctly uses data.image_urls after server.py fix

dealdetails_delete_image_button.details: Trash icon button on main carousel image with data-testid='delete-image-{currentImageIndex}', calls DELETE endpoint

dealdetails_thumbnail_delete_and_reorder.details: Thumbnail strip has X delete button (data-testid='thumb-delete-{idx}') and ← → reorder buttons (data-testid='thumb-move-left/right-{idx}')

panel_asking_price_field_fix.details: EditableField field='asking_price', handleSave uses editedData.asking_price — was broken as 'price' before

panel_size_sqft_field_fix.details: EditableField field='size_sqft', handleSave uses editedData.size_sqft — was broken as 'size' before

panel_delete_image_button.details: Red trash icon on main carousel image (data-testid='panel-delete-image-{currentImageIndex}'), isDeal-gated, calls handleDeleteImage

panel_thumbnail_strip_delete.details: Thumbnail strip shown for isDeal && images.length > 1. Each thumbnail has X button (data-testid='panel-thumb-delete-{idx}')

panel_save_syncs_parent.details: handleSave calls onUpdate() → handlePanelUpdate() in MapView.js which re-fetches deal from backend and calls updateDealInState

server_py_post_image_urls_fix.details: CRITICAL BUG: POST /api/deals/{deal_id}/images was returning only image_url (singular), not image_urls (array). Frontend expects image_urls to update carousel. Fixed by adding image_urls to response.

action_items: Minor: handleMoveImage in DealDetails.js does not revert state if reorder API call fails (shows toast but keeps new order in UI). Consider reverting state on failure.
Note: PropertyIntelligencePanel thumbnail strip only shows when images.length > 1 — single-image deals won't show thumbnails (as designed per requirements).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: server.py POST /api/deals/{deal_id}/images (line 292) was NOT returning image_urls array — only image_url (singular). Both DealDetails.js and PropertyIntelligencePanel.js call `data.image_urls` after upload, which was undefined, causing TypeError and 'Failed to upload image' toast. Added image_urls to response.

Duplicate route: Both server.py (line 242) and routes_v2/deals.py (line 710) define POST /api/deals/{deal_id}/images. FastAPI matches server.py version first (defined before include_router). The deals.py version is never reached for POST. This redundancy should be cleaned up.
handleMoveImage in DealDetails.js: optimistic update is not reverted on API failure — user sees new order in UI even if backend save failed.
PropertyIntelligencePanel.js is 2901 lines — should be refactored into sub-components per code quality guidelines (>700 lines)

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all features verified via code review; image upload fix applied)
